title: Van Westendorp response
description: One respondent's four Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity Meter thresholds. The analyzer additionally requires strict ascending order.

tooCheap.description: Price at which quality becomes doubtful because the offer is too cheap.

cheap.description: Price at which the offer is perceived as cheap or a bargain.

expensive.description: Price at which the offer is perceived as expensive but still worth considering.

tooExpensive.description: Price at which the offer is too expensive to consider.
